item.title: What's New in PyScript Next (2023.11.1)
item.description: Today marks the release of PyScript 2023.11.1, a ground-up total-rewrite of PyScript that adds a wide swath of new functionality, smaller file sizes, faster loading, and so much more. This post (and really, this release) is a doozy, so get your brains in gear.
